entities.name: Experimental double cortex
observations: In Dcx-knockdown rat subcortical band heterotopia, most bicuculline-induced interictal-like discharges began in overlying normotopic cortex and propagated into the heterotopic band; suppressing band excitability did not remove heightened pentylenetetrazole seizure susceptibility.

Bilateral Dcx-knockdown rats developed spontaneous nonconvulsive spike-wave events, demonstrating epileptogenicity of the broader malformation-associated network without proving heterotopic-band onset.
In Eml1-deficient tish rats, early spontaneous spike-wave bursts were associated with bilateral heterotopic dysplastic cortex, but onset was not localized to normotopic versus heterotopic tissue.

entities.name: Normotopic cortex
observations: Best-supported primary epileptogenic compartment in the searched experimental double-cortex literature: most localized interictal-like discharges began here and then propagated into the SBH band.
Dcx-associated heterotopia can remodel normotopic cortical excitability and synaptic excitation/inhibition balance, providing a mechanism for seizure susceptibility.

entities.name: Heterotopic cortex
observations: Participates in an abnormal interconnected circuit and receives propagated normotopic discharges, but was not a primary source in the strongest direct localization study.
Occasional hemisphere-level seizure initiation in bilateral Dcx-SBH rats cannot distinguish heterotopic band from adjacent normotopic tissue; direct band-first onset evidence was not identified.
